# Fire Stopping

> Fire Stopping provides comprehensive firestopping, fireproofing, and building protection services including intumescent coatings, spray foam insulation, and fire caulking solutions compliant with UL and ASTM standards.

Based in Pennsylvania, Fire Stopping specializes in commercial and industrial fire protection services with 24/7 availability. The company offers a full range of firestopping products and installation services to meet building code compliance and fire safety requirements.

## Key Topics

- Firestopping Services
- Intumescent Coatings
- Spray Foam Insulation
- Fire Caulking
- Fire-Rated Materials
- UL/ASTM Standards
- Building Code Compliance
- Structural Steel Fireproofing
- Silicone Roof Coatings
- Fire Safety
- Commercial-Industrial Applications
- Intumescent Sealants
- Fire Putty
- 24/7 Service
